model_requirements.notes: Local audio import has no synthesis model or voice ID. Use the current local importer contract: an actual WAV plus matching word timestamps, or replace speech with clips matching every caption in order. Do not include both modes. No guessed whole-recording timestamps.

local_audio_note: Unreviewed template only. Replace speech with the exact episode speech configuration. After reviewing the actual audio and timestamps, set local_audio_sha256 to the complete project-relative path -> SHA-256 map from local_audio.source_signature(speech, root, require_exists=True): both WAV and timestamp JSON for full-recording mode, or every clip for clips mode. Preserve the actual reviewer response and findings; change status only after that review really occurred, then bind episode.audio_direction.request_text_sha256 and review_sha256. A hash match alone does not establish listening or human acceptance.
